title: GatewayRequest
description: A single unit of incoming work submitted to a gateway. Identical objects are replayed through both gateways for a fair comparison.

requestId.description: Unique id (uuid v4 in the simulator).

type.description: Job type; drives the executor and the ML feature vector.

payloadSize.description: Request/payload size in bytes. Contributes to transfer cost and some CPU cost.

precision.description: full = real work; reduced = downgraded variant (less CPU/IO).

arrivalTs.description: Scheduled arrival timestamp produced by the simulator.
